---
title: "Quiz · Find the Technical Truth"
---

A short knowledge check. Answers are hidden behind callouts so you can
self-grade after answering.

## 1. Why must the technical model come before the metaphor?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
Starting with a metaphor risks smuggling in assumptions that may not be true and
leaving out facts that matter. The technical model ensures the story is grounded
in reality before any creative transformation begins.
:::

## 2. Name the six categories to extract from a technical system.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
Actors, resources, responsibilities, relationships, events, and state
transitions.
:::

## 3. What is the purpose of the "key facts" section in concept.md?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
It lists hard constraints that any metaphor must never violate. This is the safety
net against metaphor drift and misconception injection.
:::

## 4. Should concept.md contain any narrative or metaphorical language?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
No. The concept must be plain-language engineering truth with no restaurant
imagery, character names, dialogue, or scenes. Metaphor is added in a separate
stage.
:::

## 5. What happens if a metaphor contradicts a fact in the concept?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
The metaphor changes, not the model. The technical truth is always authoritative.
:::
